title: Production publish readiness (frontend build, assets, and deploy verification)

requirements.summary: Ensure production preflight checks pass, the frontend builds successfully, and all UI-referenced static assets exist at absolute /assets/... paths (including header logo).
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm typescript-check` completes with no TypeScript errors.
All referenced static assets load in the production build (no 404s for `/assets/...`, including `/assets/IMG-20260210-WA0045-4.jpg` and any `/assets/generated/...` paths used by the app).

file_operations.description: Fix any incorrect static asset references so logo paths match real files under frontend/public/assets/... and remain absolute /assets/... (notably align the generated logo filenames with the existing terra-vedant-*.png assets).
Add the header logo image file at the exact path required by the UI (`/assets/IMG-20260210-WA0045-4.jpg`) so production build does not 404.
Ensure the generated standard logo asset exists at this exact path for production (/assets/generated/terra-vedant-logo.dim_128x128.png).
Ensure the generated large logo asset exists at this exact path for production (/assets/generated/terra-vedant-logo.dim_512x512.png).
Ensure the hero background image exists at this exact path so the hero section does not 404 in production (/assets/generated/terra-vedant-tech-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png).

Update the deployment guide to include an explicit production preflight checklist covering `pnpm typescript-check`, `pnpm build:skip-bindings`, and verification that all `/assets/...` references used by the UI (including `/assets/IMG-20260210-WA0045-4.jpg` and `/assets/generated/...`) exist in frontend/public/assets before building. Also reference the selected components build-template-react and github-export-icp-cli as the source of build/deploy conventions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small preflight script that scans known UI asset constants and key UI source files for `/assets/` string literals and verifies the corresponding files exist under frontend/public (failing the script if any are missing), to prevent production 404s.

requirements.summary: Support production deployment verification by ensuring the deployed site renders reliably (no blank screen), and the header brand text + logo render correctly in production.
acceptanceCriteria: On the production URL, the site loads without a blank screen and without critical console errors.
The site header shows the brand text and the header logo image renders (not broken).

file_operations.description: Add a lightweight React error boundary with a minimal fallback UI to prevent a blank screen if an unexpected render error occurs in production.
Wrap the existing single-page layout (header, sections, footer) in the new ProductionErrorBoundary so production rendering failures show a fallback instead of a blank screen.

Harden header logo rendering for production by ensuring it uses the centralized BRAND_ASSETS path (absolute /assets/...) and includes a safe, non-empty alt text; keep the existing shadcn-ui Button usage composed as-is (do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a production verification section with steps to confirm the deployed URL renders header/sections/footer, confirm the header shows brand text, and confirm the header logo loads (no broken image) and that the console has no critical errors. Also reference the selected component github-export-icp-cli for Internet Computer deployment workflow; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
